Let $A(-16, 4)$ and $B(12, 0)$. Find $|\overrightarrow{AB}|$." :question/worked-solution "We have

$$
\begin{aligned}
\overrightarrow{OA} &= a = - 16 i + 4 j, \\
\overrightarrow{OB} &= b = 12 i.
\end{aligned}
$$

Expressing $\overrightarrow{AB}$ as the difference of position vectors, we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\overrightarrow{AB} &= \overrightarrow{OB} - \overrightarrow{OA} \\
&= b - a \\
&= (12 i) - (- 16 i + 4 j) \\
&= 28 i - 4 j
\end{aligned}
$$

Now, using the formula for the magnitude of a vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}
|\overrightarrow{AB}| &= \sqrt{(28)^{2} + (-4)^{2}} \\
&= \sqrt{784 + 16} \\
&= \sqrt{800} \\
&= 20 \sqrt{2}
\end{aligned}
$$" :question/requires-calculator false :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["b49bb760-a1d5-54eb-84a1-6966067cef0b"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "1da9c0a6-14cc-517f-a698-c8a70ee46bb8" :answer/id #uuid "1da9c0a6-14cc-517f-a698-c8a70ee46bb8" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "9 \sqrt{3}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "fd3387cd-5801-5797-af72-00603e84116c" :answer/id #uuid "fd3387cd-5801-5797-af72-00603e84116c" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "3 \sqrt{23}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "5bdee396-6d9f-5bbe-8378-a50d04de0635" :answer/id #uuid "5bdee396-6d9f-5bbe-8378-a50d04de0635" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "24" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "45e58fef-c1c7-52df-807b-c1a8f907804d" :answer/id #uuid "45e58fef-c1c7-52df-807b-c1a8f907804d" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "15" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "df2d382e-5a80-52bc-a649-14e4acf7e481" :answer/id #uuid "df2d382e-5a80-52bc-a649-14e4acf7e481" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "3 \sqrt{26}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "b7666596-5028-5069-996f-ad5e72c1af9c" :answer-field/id #uuid "b7666596-5028-5069-996f-ad5e72c1af9c" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["1da9c0a6-14cc-517f-a698-c8a70ee46bb8" "fd3387cd-5801-5797-af72-00603e84116c" "5bdee396-6d9f-5bbe-8378-a50d04de0635" "45e58fef-c1c7-52df-807b-c1a8f907804d" "df2d382e-5a80-52bc-a649-14e4acf7e481"] :answer-field/correct "df2d382e-5a80-52bc-a649-14e4acf7e481" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "ff8c4899-ff23-5168-90d9-e8d647d7f269" :question/id #uuid "ff8c4899-ff23-5168-90d9-e8d647d7f269" :question/problem "![](images/6b/6bd80d88ece15997923e5860ff1328dea542c2950c9e4399eba6a5e872070f18.png)

Let $P(-6, 6)$ and $Q(9, 9)$. Find $|\overrightarrow{PQ}|$." :question/worked-solution "We have

$$
\begin{aligned}
\overrightarrow{OP} &= p = - 6 i + 6 j, \\
\overrightarrow{OQ} &= q = 9 i + 9 j.
\end{aligned}

Expressing $\overrightarrow{PQ}$ as the difference of position vectors, we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\overrightarrow{PQ} &= \overrightarrow{OQ} - \overrightarrow{OP} \\
&= q - p \\
&= (9 i + 9 j) - (- 6 i + 6 j) \\
&= 15 i + 3 j
\end{aligned}
$$

Now, using the formula for the magnitude of a vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}

&= \sqrt{234} \\
&= 3 \sqrt{26}
\end{aligned}
